## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and Financials + Industrials both negative; leadership is narrow (Top 5: 4/5 Energy), but a MAJOR divergence (TSLA, UNH, PFE showing 1W vs 1M flips) tempers the call—watch for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.80%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing isolated strength: DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities modestly positive at sector level (sector breadth: 2/11 sectors positive).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Industrials lag: EMR (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare weak: LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND. Technology under pressure overall (sector 1W: -0.72%; breadth weak).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +8.38% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND; COP (1W: +7.64% | 1M: +11.12%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy) — cyclical/value tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EMR (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND; PSA (1W: -5.54% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND; EL (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -17.60%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND; AVGO (1W: -6.21% | 1M: -1.19%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials, select Tech and Staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND. Watch RECOVERY signals as divergences: TSLA (1W: +0.01% | 1M: -4.35%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure with mixed internals; AAPL (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND while GOOGL (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +1.77%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND provide pockets of support; sector 1W: -0.72%.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are weak on the week: JPM (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.90% | 1M: -1.79%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.58% | 1M: -2.27%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: -1.01% and contributes to the RISK-OFF confirmation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare pressured: LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND, while UNH (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY is a short-term bright spot; sector 1W: -1.77%.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select cyclicals (XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.80%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech (AAPL (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND) and health laggards like LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical favored, but MAJOR divergence advises tactical caution and close monitoring.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.80%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +10.17%, 10 stocks) — continued leadership would reinforce Value/Cyclical. BEARISH: Industrials (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -5.32%) and Healthcare (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -4.26%) — weakness here reinforces RISK-OFF.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor XOM holding this week’s breakout to confirm continuation (XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND). Watch NVDA (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND to reclaim 1M strength as a material regime signal. A failure for AAPL (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%) BELOW TREND to stabilize will keep Tech under pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+50): Nvidia GTC optimism; NVDA (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines diverge from price, signposting distribution. PFE (+55): Positive trial results; PFE (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirms short-term accumulation. AVGO (+50): AI/optical upgrade; AVGO (1W: -6.21% | 1M: -1.19%) BELOW TREND — positive news but price declining, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-65): CEO exit and downgrade; ADBE (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms weakness. FCX (-50): Grasberg rights extension concern; FCX (1W: -6.91% | 1M: -7.56%) BELOW TREND — confirmed downside. NEM (-45): gold weakness; NEM (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -11.55%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical favored. XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.80%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence (TSLA, UNH, PFE in RECOVERY) and bullish headlines on NVDA/AVGO while prices remain BELOW TREND—monitor for trend breaks and distribution.
